  html,body{margin:0}
  body{
    font-family:var(--font);
    color:var(--ink);
    background:var(--bg);
    line-height:1.4;
    -webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;
    padding-bottom:60px;
  }

  /* ---- Toolbar ---- */
  .toolbar{
    position:sticky; top:0; z-index:20;
    display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; align-items:center; gap:8px;
    padding:10px 16px;
    background:rgba(255,255,255,.85);
    backdrop-filter:saturate(180%) blur(8px);
    border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);
  }
  .toolbar .brand{font-weight:700; letter-spacing:.04em; margin-right:auto; font-size:14px}
  .toolbar .brand span{color:var(--accent)}
  .btn{
    font:inherit; font-size:13px; font-weight:600;
    border:1px solid var(--line2); background:#fff; color:var(--ink);
    padding:7px 12px; border-radius:8px; cursor:pointer;
    transition:background .12s, border-color .12s, transform .02s;
  }
  .btn:hover{background:var(--accent-soft); border-color:var(--accent)}
  .btn:active{transform:translateY(1px)}
  .btn.primary{background:var(--accent); color:#fff; border-color:var(--accent)}
  .btn.primary:hover{filter:brightness(1.08)}
  .btn.ghost{border-color:transparent; background:transparent; color:var(--muted)}
  .btn.ghost:hover{color:var(--ink); background:var(--accent-soft)}
  .btn.danger{background:#b42318; color:#fff; border-color:#b42318}
  .btn.danger:hover{filter:brightness(1.1); background:#b42318; border-color:#b42318}
  .status{font-size:12px; color:var(--muted); min-width:54px}

  /* ---- Sheet layout ---- */
  .sheet{max-width:1120px; margin:22px auto; padding:0 16px}
  .card{
    background:var(--card); border:1px solid var(--line);
    border-radius:var(--radius); box-shadow:var(--shadow);
    padding:16px 18px; margin-bottom:16px;
  }
  .card > h2, .atk-top h2{
    margin:0 0 12px; font-size:11px; font-weight:700;
    letter-spacing:.12em; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--accent);
  }
  .columns{display:grid; grid-template-columns:352px 1fr; gap:16px; align-items:stretch}
  @media (max-width:860px){ .columns{grid-template-columns:1fr} }
  /* let the Senses / Proficiencies cards soak up the leftover height in their column */
  .card.grow{flex:1 1 auto; display:flex; flex-direction:column}
  .card.grow .ta-print{flex:1 1 auto}   /* print: the visible mirror fills the page (textarea is hidden in print) */

  label.lbl{display:block; font-size:10px; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:.09em;
    text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--muted); margin-bottom:3px}

  input,select,textarea{
    font:inherit; color:var(--ink); width:100%;
    background:var(--field); border:1px solid var(--line);
    border-radius:8px; padding:7px 9px;
  }
  input:focus,select:focus,textarea:focus{outline:2px solid var(--accent-soft); border-color:var(--accent)}
  input[type=number]{appearance:textfield; -moz-appearance:textfield}
  textarea{resize:vertical; min-height:140px; line-height:1.6}   /* roomy enough to hand-write a blank copy */
  .ta-print{display:none}

  /* Header */
  .charname input{font-size:24px; font-weight:700; background:transparent;
    border:none; border-bottom:2px solid var(--line2); border-radius:0; padding:4px 2px}
  .charname input:focus{border-bottom-color:var(--accent); outline:none}
  .header-grid{display:flex; align-items:stretch; gap:16px}
  .header-main{flex:1; min-width:0; display:flex; flex-direction:column}
  .portrait{position:relative; flex:none; width:150px; height:190px; align-self:flex-start;
    border:1px solid var(--line2); background:var(--field); cursor:pointer; overflow:hidden;
    display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center}
  .portrait.has-img{background:transparent}
  .portrait img{position:absolute; inset:0; width:100%; height:100%; object-fit:contain}  /* fit whole image to height, no crop */
  .portrait img[hidden]{display:none}
  .sheet.hide-portrait #portrait{display:none !important}   /* Settings → General: hide the portrait box on screen and in print */
  .portrait-empty{display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; gap:3px; text-align:center; padding:0 6px}
  .pe-main{font-size:10px; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:.07em; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--muted)}
  .pe-sub{font-size:9px; color:var(--muted)}
  .portrait-menu{display:none; position:absolute; left:6px; right:6px; bottom:6px; flex-direction:column; gap:3px; z-index:6}
  .portrait.menu-open .portrait-menu{display:flex}
  .portrait-menu button{font:inherit; font-size:11px; font-weight:600; text-align:center; cursor:pointer;
    border:1px solid var(--line2); background:#fff; color:var(--ink); padding:6px 8px}
  .portrait-menu button:hover{background:var(--accent-soft); border-color:var(--accent)}
  .meta-grid{display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr); gap:10px 14px; margin-top:14px}
  .xp-wrap{display:flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; flex-wrap:wrap}
  .xp-wrap > #xp{flex:1; min-width:64px}
  .xp-add{width:74px}
  .btn#btn-addxp{font-size:11px; padding:3px 10px}
  .xp-status{font-size:11px; color:var(--muted); flex-basis:100%}
  .wiz-leveltarget-banner{background:#fff7ed; border:1px solid #fed7aa; color:#9a3412; padding:8px 12px; font-size:13px; font-weight:600; margin-bottom:12px}
  .btn.xp-levelup{position:relative; overflow:hidden; font-size:11px; font-weight:700; padding:3px 12px; letter-spacing:.02em;
    color:#3d2c00; border-color:#9a7b12; text-shadow:0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.35);
    background:linear-gradient(135deg,#a9801a 0%,#ffe9a3 22%,#e3b62e 48%,#ffe9a3 74%,#a9801a 100%)}
  .btn.xp-levelup::after{content:""; position:absolute; top:0; bottom:0; left:-80%; width:60%; pointer-events:none;
    background:linear-gradient(100deg, transparent 0%, rgba(255,255,255,.95) 50%, transparent 100%); transform:skewX(-18deg);
    animation:xp-gleam 3.6s ease-in-out infinite}
  @keyframes xp-gleam{0%,50%{left:-80%} 100%{left:180%}}
  @media print{ .btn.xp-levelup{display:none} }
  @media (max-width:560px){ .meta-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)} }

  /* Source-data build pickers */

  /* Ability-score method selector */
  .modes{display:flex; gap:4px; background:var(--field); border:1px solid var(--line);
    border-radius:9px; padding:3px; margin-bottom:8px}
  .mode-btn{flex:1; font:inherit; font-size:11px; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:.02em;
    border:none; background:transparent; color:var(--muted); padding:6px 4px; border-radius:7px; cursor:pointer}
  .mode-btn:hover{color:var(--ink)}
  .mode-btn.active{background:#fff; color:var(--accent); box-shadow:var(--shadow)}
  .gen-status{font-size:11px; color:var(--muted); margin-bottom:10px; min-height:15px}
  .gen-status .over{color:#b42318; font-weight:700}
  .gen-status .chip-val{display:inline-block; padding:1px 7px; margin:0 2px; border-radius:5px;
    background:var(--accent-soft); color:var(--accent); font-weight:700; font-size:11px}
  .gen-status .chip-val.used{opacity:.32; text-decoration:line-through}

  /* Abilities */
  .ability-head{display:flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; padding-bottom:5px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line2)}
  .ability-head .name{flex:1; min-width:0}
  .ability-head .col{width:40px; flex:none; text-align:center; font-size:8px; font-weight:700;
    letter-spacing:.03em; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--muted); line-height:1.1; white-space:nowrap}
  .ability{display:flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; padding:8px 0; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
  .ability:last-child{border-bottom:none}
  .ability .name{flex:1; min-width:0; font-size:11px; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:.01em;
    text-transform:uppercase; overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis; white-space:nowrap}
  .ability .score{width:40px; flex:none}
  .ability .score input{text-align:center; font-size:18px; font-weight:700; padding:0; height:40px; box-sizing:border-box}
  .ability .mod{
    width:40px; height:40px; flex:none; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
    font-size:20px; font-weight:700; color:var(--accent); background:var(--accent-soft); border-radius:8px;
  }
  .stepper{display:flex; align-items:center; gap:1px}
  .stepper .step{width:21px; height:30px; flex:none; border:1px solid var(--line2); background:#fff;
    border-radius:6px; font-size:16px; font-weight:700; color:var(--accent); cursor:pointer; line-height:1; padding:0}
  .stepper .step:hover:not(:disabled){background:var(--accent-soft)}
  .stepper .step:disabled{opacity:.3; cursor:default}
  .stepper .basev{width:22px; text-align:center; font-size:17px; font-weight:700}
  .score-out{width:40px; height:40px; flex:none; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
    font-size:19px; font-weight:700; border:1px solid var(--line2); background:#fff; box-sizing:border-box}

  /* "Under the hood" — generation method + per-ability base & bonus inputs (modal) */
  .hood-grid-head, .hood-row{display:grid; grid-template-columns:72px 72px repeat(4,1fr); gap:6px; align-items:center}
  .hood-grid-head{font-size:8px; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:.04em; text-transform:uppercase;
    color:var(--muted); text-align:center; margin-bottom:5px}
  .hood-grid-head .hname{text-align:left}
  .hood-row{padding:5px 0; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
  .hood-row:last-child{border-bottom:none}
  .hood-row .hname{font-size:10px; font-weight:700; text-transform:uppercase}
  .hood-row input, .hood-row select{width:100%; box-sizing:border-box; text-align:center; padding:3px 2px; font-weight:700}
  .hood-row .stepper{justify-content:center}

  /* ASI / Feat attention flag (pulses until every improvement is chosen) */
  .asi-flag{display:block; width:100%; margin:0 0 10px; text-align:left; cursor:pointer;
    border:1px solid #c2410c; border-left-width:4px; background:#fff7ed; color:#7c2d12;
    padding:11px 15px; font:inherit; font-weight:700; font-size:14px; letter-spacing:.01em}
  .asi-flag + .asi-flag{margin-top:-4px}   /* when both flags show, read as one stacked block */
  .asi-flag:hover{background:#ffedd5}
  .asi-flag .sub{display:block; font-weight:500; font-size:11px; color:#9a3412; margin-top:3px}
  /* ASI picker modal rows */
  .asi-slot{border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:10px; padding:10px 12px; margin-bottom:10px}
  .asi-slot.done{border-color:#16a34a; background:#f0fdf4}
  .asi-slot-head{display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; font-weight:700; font-size:12px; margin-bottom:7px}
  .asi-slot-head .badge{font-size:9px; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:.05em; text-transform:uppercase;
    padding:2px 7px; border-radius:999px; background:#fee2e2; color:#991b1b}
  .asi-slot.done .badge{background:#dcfce7; color:#166534}
  .asi-type{display:flex; gap:16px; font-size:12px; margin-bottom:7px}
  .asi-type label{display:flex; align-items:center; gap:5px; font-weight:600; cursor:pointer}
  .asi-body{display:flex; gap:10px; flex-wrap:wrap; align-items:center; font-size:12px}
  .asi-body label{font-size:10px; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:.04em; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--muted)}
  .asi-body select{width:auto; min-width:120px}
  .asi-featdesc{font-size:12px; color:var(--muted); line-height:1.5; white-space:pre-line; max-height:160px; overflow:auto; margin-top:6px; padding:6px 8px; border:1px solid var(--line)}
  .sp-caster-head{font-size:13px; font-weight:700; color:var(--accent); margin:12px 0 2px; border-top:1px solid var(--line); padding-top:10px}
  .sp-caster-head:first-child{border-top:0; padding-top:0}
  details.sp-caster{border-top:1px solid var(--line); margin-top:8px}
  details.sp-caster:first-of-type{border-top:0; margin-top:0}
  details.sp-caster > summary.sp-caster-head{cursor:pointer; list-style:none; user-select:none; border-top:0; padding-top:10px; margin:0}
  details.sp-caster:first-of-type > summary.sp-caster-head{padding-top:2px}
  details.sp-caster > summary.sp-caster-head::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}
  details.sp-caster > summary.sp-caster-head::before{content:"▸ "; color:var(--muted)}
  details.sp-caster[open] > summary.sp-caster-head::before{content:"▾ "}
  .sp-caster-body{padding-bottom:8px}
  .asi-scores{display:flex; gap:6px; margin-bottom:12px}
  .asi-score{flex:1; text-align:center; border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:8px; padding:5px 2px}
  .asi-score .ab{display:block; font-size:9px; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:.05em; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--muted)}
  .asi-score .sc{display:block; font-size:17px; font-weight:700; line-height:1.1}
  .asi-score .md{display:block; font-size:11px; color:var(--muted)}

  /* small stat chips */
  .chips{display:flex; gap:10px; flex-wrap:wrap}
  .chip{flex:1; min-width:90px; text-align:center; background:var(--field);
    border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:10px; padding:8px 6px}
  .chip .v{font-size:22px; font-weight:700; color:var(--accent)}
  .chip .k{font-size:9px; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:.09em; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--muted)}
  .chip.on{background:var(--accent); border-color:var(--accent)}
  .chip.on .v,.chip.on .k{color:#fff}

  /* rows of save/skill */
  .row{display:flex; align-items:center; gap:9px; padding:5px 0; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
  .row:last-child{border-bottom:none}
  .row .total{width:40px; height:40px; flex:none; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
    font-weight:700; font-size:19px; background:var(--accent-soft); color:var(--accent); border-radius:8px}
  .row .rname{flex:1; font-size:13px}
  .row .rname .ab{color:var(--muted); font-size:10px; font-weight:700; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:.05em}
  .marks{display:flex; gap:6px; align-items:center}
  .marks label{display:flex; align-items:center; gap:3px; font-size:9px; color:var(--muted);
    font-weight:700; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:.04em; cursor:pointer}
  input[type=checkbox],input[type=radio]{width:16px; height:16px; accent-color:var(--accent); cursor:pointer; flex:none}

  .passive{display:flex; align-items:center; gap:12px; margin-bottom:12px}
  .passive .v{flex:none; width:40px; height:40px; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
    font-size:19px; font-weight:700; color:var(--accent); background:#fff; border:2px solid var(--accent)}
  .passive .k{font-size:12px; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:.06em; text-transform:uppercase;
    color:var(--ink); line-height:1.3}

  /* combat */
  .combat-top{display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr); gap:10px}
  .topstats{display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; gap:10px}
  .stat{background:var(--field); border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:10px; padding:8px; text-align:center}
  .stat .k{font-size:9px; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:.08em; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--muted)}
  .stat input{text-align:center; font-size:18px; font-weight:700; background:transparent; border:none; padding:2px}
  .stat .calc{font-size:18px; font-weight:700; color:var(--accent)}
  /* AC / Initiative / Speed / HP: tighter, uniform-size boxes (values keep the standard .stat size) */
  .combat-top .stat, .hp-grid .stat{padding:5px 6px; min-height:52px; display:flex; flex-direction:column; justify-content:center}
  .combat-top .stat .k, .hp-grid .stat .k{margin-bottom:1px}
  .combat-top .stat input, .hp-grid .stat input{padding:0}
  .combat-top:not(.hd-grid) .stat{justify-content:flex-start}   /* labels (Armor Class/Initiative/Speed) pinned to the top of their boxes */
  .combat-top.hd-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr); gap:8px}   /* Hit Dice: all 4 boxes on one line */
  .stat.toggle-stat{cursor:pointer; user-select:none}
  .stat.on{background:var(--accent); border-color:var(--accent)}
  .stat.on .k,.stat.on .calc{color:#fff}
  .hp-grid{display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr); gap:10px; margin-top:12px}
  .deathsaves{display:flex; align-items:center; gap:16px; margin-top:12px}
  .deathsaves .ds-title{font-size:12px; font-weight:800; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:.06em; color:var(--ink)}
  .ds-rows{display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:8px}   /* Failures stacked under Successes */
  .deathsaves .grp{display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px}
  .deathsaves .grp .k{font-size:10px; font-weight:700; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:.06em; color:var(--muted);
    width:74px; flex:none; text-align:center}   /* fixed label column so Successes/Failures pips line up + words center on each other */
  .pips{display:flex; gap:5px}
  .topblock{display:grid; grid-template-columns:332px 1fr; gap:16px; align-items:stretch}   /* Combat/PB squished to the min that keeps every box label on one line; Resistances takes the rest */
  .topblock-left{display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:16px; min-width:0}
  .topblock-left .stat .k{white-space:nowrap}
  .topblock-left > .card{margin:0}
  .defenses-card{margin:0; display:flex; flex-direction:column}
  .defenses-card textarea{flex:1 1 auto; min-height:120px; line-height:1.5}
  @media (max-width:640px){ .topblock{grid-template-columns:1fr} }
  #proficiencies{min-height:72px}   /* compact floor; auto-grows to content */

  /* attacks */
  table{width:100%; border-collapse:collapse}
  th{font-size:9px; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:.08em; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--muted); text-align:left; padding:4px 6px}
  td{padding:3px 4px}
  td input{background:var(--field)}
  .attacks td:nth-child(2) input{text-align:center}

  /* guided creation modal */
  .modal{position:fixed; inset:0; z-index:50; display:none; background:rgba(26,29,35,.45);
    align-items:flex-start; justify-content:center; padding:48px 16px; overflow:auto}
  .modal.open{display:flex}
  .modal-panel{background:#fff; border:1px solid var(--line2); width:100%; max-width:460px}
  #wizard .modal-panel{max-width:960px}   /* roomy: class list + 1–20 detail + spell/feat pickers */
  #wizard.modal{padding:24px 16px}
  #wizard .modal-body{min-height:420px}
  #wizard .wiz-build{grid-template-columns:220px 1fr}
  #wizard #wiz-class-list, #wizard #wiz-race-list{max-height:440px}
  #wizard .wiz-cd-table{max-height:380px}
  @media (max-width:680px){ #wizard .modal-panel{max-width:460px} #wizard .wiz-build{grid-template-columns:1fr} #wizard #wiz-class-list, #wizard #wiz-race-list{max-height:200px} }
  .modal-head{display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; padding:14px 18px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
  .modal-head h2{margin:0; font-size:12px; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:.1em; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--accent)}
  .modal-body{padding:18px; min-height:120px}
  /* Settings: left-side section tabs + right-side content */
  .settings-panel{max-width:660px}
  .settings-wrap{display:flex; min-height:320px}
  .settings-nav{flex:none; width:158px; border-right:1px solid var(--line); padding:12px 0; display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:2px}
  .settings-nav .set-tab{font:inherit; font-size:13px; font-weight:600; text-align:left; padding:8px 16px; background:none; border:none; border-left:2px solid transparent; cursor:pointer; color:var(--muted)}
  .settings-nav .set-tab:hover{color:var(--ink)}
  .settings-nav .set-tab.active{color:var(--accent); border-left-color:var(--accent); background:var(--accent-soft)}
  .settings-content{flex:1; padding:18px; min-height:120px; overflow:auto}
  .set-sec{display:none}
  .set-sec.active{display:block}
  .sheet.no-addspell [data-addspellsheet]{display:none !important}   /* Settings → Spells: hide the + Add spell sheet button (created sheets stay) */
  @media (max-width:560px){
    .settings-wrap{flex-direction:column}
    .settings-nav{width:auto; flex-direction:row; border-right:none; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line); overflow-x:auto}
    .settings-nav .set-tab{border-left:none; border-bottom:2px solid transparent; white-space:nowrap}
    .settings-nav .set-tab.active{border-bottom-color:var(--accent)}
  }
  .wiz-hint{font-size:11px; color:var(--muted); margin:10px 0 0; line-height:1.55; white-space:pre-line}
  .wiz-methods{display:flex; gap:6px}
  .wiz-methods .btn{flex:1}
  .btn.wiz-equip.active{background:var(--accent); color:#fff; border-color:var(--accent)}
  .wiz-racechoice{margin-top:10px; padding-top:10px; border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
  .wiz-race-lore{margin-top:10px}
  .wiz-race-lore > summary{cursor:pointer; font-size:12px; font-weight:700; color:var(--muted); list-style:none; user-select:none}
  .wiz-race-lore > summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}
  .wiz-race-lore > summary::before{content:"▸ "; font-weight:700}
  .wiz-race-lore[open] > summary::before{content:"▾ "}
  .wiz-racechoice .wiz-radio{display:block; font-size:14px; font-weight:600; margin:4px 0; cursor:pointer}
  .wiz-racechoice select{margin:2px 0}
  .wiz-skill{display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; padding:5px 2px; font-size:14px; font-weight:600; cursor:pointer}
  .wiz-skill input:disabled + span{opacity:.4}
  .wiz-skill.maxed input:not(:checked){opacity:.35; cursor:default}
  .wiz-skill.taken{opacity:.45} .wiz-skill.taken span{text-decoration:line-through}
  /* Multiclass class builder (step 2) */
  .wiz-build{display:grid; grid-template-columns:170px 1fr; gap:12px; align-items:start}
  .wiz-build-list{display:flex; flex-direction:column}
  #wiz-class-list, #wiz-race-list{display:flex; flex-direction:column; border:1px solid var(--line); max-height:340px; overflow:auto}

  #wiz-chosen{margin-top:14px}

  .wiz-chosen-row .nm{font-weight:700; flex:1}
  .wiz-chosen-row .badge{font-size:10px; font-weight:700; color:#fff; background:var(--accent); padding:1px 6px; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:.04em}
  .wiz-chosen-row input[type=number]{width:56px}
  .wiz-chosen-row .x{background:none; border:0; color:var(--muted); font-size:15px; cursor:pointer; padding:2px 6px}
  .wiz-chosen-row .x:hover{color:#b91c1c}
  #wiz-hp{margin-top:14px}

  #wiz-hp .hp-modes .btn{flex:1}
  #wiz-hp .hp-modes .btn.active{background:var(--accent); color:#fff; border-color:var(--accent)}
  #wiz-hp .hp-rows{border:1px solid var(--line); max-height:200px; overflow:auto; margin-top:6px}
  .hp-row{display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; padding:5px 10px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line); font-size:13px}
  .hp-row:last-child{border-bottom:0}
  .hp-row .lv{font-weight:700; width:46px; flex:none}
  .hp-row .die{color:var(--muted); flex:1}
  .hp-row input{width:52px}

  #wiz-hp .hp-total{font-weight:700; margin-top:8px; font-size:14px}
  #wiz-spells{margin-top:14px}
  .sp-pick-grp{font-size:11px; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:.04em; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--muted); margin:10px 0 4px}
  .sp-pick-list{border:1px solid var(--line); padding:4px 10px; max-height:300px; overflow:auto}

  /* shared list of selectable items with a collapsible full description (feats + spells) */

  .wiz-pend-row{display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; padding:6px 8px; border:1px solid #fed7aa; background:#fff7ed; margin:5px 0; font-size:13px}
  .wiz-pend-row .lbl2{flex:1; font-weight:600; margin:0}
  .wiz-pend-row select{max-width:200px}
  .equip-line{margin-top:6px}

  .equip-fixed{display:block; padding:3px 2px; font-size:13px; color:var(--muted)}
  .modal-foot{display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; padding:14px 18px; border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
  .wiz-dots{font-size:11px; color:var(--muted); letter-spacing:.04em}

  /* ---- pages + tabs ---- */
  .pagetabs{display:flex; gap:4px; margin-bottom:16px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
  .ptab{font:inherit; font-size:13px; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:.02em; border:1px solid var(--line2);
    border-bottom:none; background:var(--field); color:var(--muted); padding:8px 16px; cursor:pointer; margin-bottom:-1px}
  .ptab:hover{color:var(--ink)}
  .ptab.active{background:#fff; color:var(--accent); border-bottom:1px solid #fff}
  .ptab.muted{opacity:.45}
  .page{display:none}
  .page.active{display:block}

  /* ---- inventory ---- */
  .coins{display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(6,1fr); gap:10px}
  .coins .coin input{text-align:center; font-size:18px; font-weight:700}
  .inv-cols{display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; gap:14px; align-items:start}
  .inv-cols .invtable{width:100%}
  @media (max-width:560px){ .inv-cols{grid-template-columns:1fr} }
  .invtable input{background:var(--field); padding:6px 5px}
  .invtable td.invitem{display:flex; align-items:center; gap:1px}
  .invtable td.invitem input{flex:1; min-width:0}
  #inv-ac{position:fixed; z-index:60; max-height:260px; overflow:auto}   /* shared per-row item autocomplete popup (positioned under the focused row) */
  .inv-del{flex:none; display:none; border:none; background:none; color:var(--muted); cursor:pointer; font-size:12px; line-height:1; padding:0 3px}
  .inv-del:hover{color:#b42318}
  .invtable tr.has-item .inv-del{display:block}   /* delete ✕ shows only on filled rows */
  .cont-caret{flex:none; width:0; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; color:var(--muted); font-size:12px; user-select:none}
  .cont-caret.show{width:15px}                                           /* the ↳ marker, only on nested rows */
  .invtable tr.in-container td.invitem{padding-left:14px}                /* nested rows indent; top-level containers stay flush */
  .invtable tr.in-container input{color:var(--muted)}   /* an item stored in a weightless container: weight not counted */
  .invdrag{cursor:grab; color:var(--muted); text-align:center; user-select:none; font-size:13px}
  .invdrag.cont-toggle{color:var(--accent); cursor:pointer}             /* container rows: drag handle doubles as collapse toggle */
  .ac-items-auto{display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:4px; margin-top:4px}
  .ac-items-auto .aci{display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; background:var(--field); border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:6px; padding:5px 8px; font-size:13px}
  .ac-items-auto .aci .b{font-weight:700; color:var(--accent)}
  .ac-items-auto .aci.pending{opacity:.55} .ac-items-auto .aci.pending .b{color:var(--muted)}
  .ac-items-auto .none{color:var(--muted); font-size:12px}
  .ac-items-write{display:none}   /* print-only blank write-in box (see @media print) */
  .invdrag:active{cursor:grabbing}
  .invtable tr.drop-target td{border-top:2px solid var(--accent)}   /* flat outline (survives the global box-shadow:none) */
  .invtable tr.drop-into td{outline:2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset:-2px; background:var(--accent-soft)}   /* dropping onto a container */
  /* Features page: a collapsible raw-text editor + one independent card per feature */
  .feat-editor{margin-bottom:12px}
  .feat-editor > summary{cursor:pointer; font-weight:600; font-size:13px; color:var(--accent); padding:4px 0; list-style:none; user-select:none}
  .feat-editor > summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}
  .feat-editor > summary::before{content:"▸ "; }
  .feat-editor[open] > summary::before{content:"▾ "; }
  .feat-cards{display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:8px}
  .feat-card-title{font-weight:700; font-size:14px; margin-bottom:3px}
  .feat-card-body{white-space:pre-wrap; line-height:1.45; font-size:13px}
  .feat-blank{display:none}   /* empty Features page: the editor is the screen input; this is a print-only full-page write-in card */
  .item-search-wrap{position:relative; margin-bottom:10px}
  .item-search-wrap input{width:100%; padding:8px 10px; background:var(--field); border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:8px; font-size:13px}
  .item-results{position:absolute; left:0; right:0; top:100%; z-index:30; background:#fff; border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:0 0 8px 8px; max-height:260px; overflow:auto; box-shadow:var(--shadow)}
  .item-results .opt{padding:7px 10px; cursor:pointer; font-size:13px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
  .item-results .opt:last-child{border-bottom:none}
  .item-results .opt.sel{background:var(--accent-soft)}
  .item-results .opt .w{color:var(--muted); font-size:11px; float:right}
  .item-results .opt.none{color:var(--muted); cursor:default}
  .invtable td:nth-child(2) input{text-align:left}                                  /* Item name → left */
  .invtable td:nth-child(3) input,.invtable td:nth-child(4) input{text-align:center} /* Qty / Wt → centered */
  .invtable th{text-align:left}
  .lftable input{background:var(--field)}
  .lftable input[title]{cursor:help}   /* auto-populated limited features show their details on hover */
  .lftable td:nth-child(2) input,.lftable td:nth-child(3) input,.lftable td:nth-child(4) input{text-align:center}
  .rowtotal{display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; margin-top:12px;
    background:var(--field); border:1px solid var(--line); padding:10px 12px}
  .rowtotal .k{font-size:10px; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:.07em; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--muted)}
  .rowtotal .v{font-size:20px; font-weight:700; color:var(--accent)}
  .encgrid{display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr); gap:10px}
  .encgrid.enc-4col{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr)}   /* variant Encumbrance off → 4 boxes on one row */
  .encgrid .stat .calc{min-height:30px; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center}
  .attune{display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr; gap:8px}   /* attuned items stacked vertically */
  .armor-attune{display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; gap:16px; align-items:start}
  .armor-attune > .card{margin-bottom:16px}
  @media (max-width:560px){ .coins{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr)} .encgrid, .encgrid.enc-4col{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)} .armor-attune{grid-template-columns:1fr} }

  /* ---- spell sheet ---- */
  .incl{display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; font-size:13px; font-weight:600}
  .lay-row{display:flex; align-items:center; gap:9px; padding:6px 2px; font-size:14px; font-weight:600;
    border-bottom:1px solid var(--line); cursor:pointer}
  .lay-row:last-child{border-bottom:none}
  .srcbook-load{display:flex; gap:8px}
  .srcbook-load select{flex:1; min-width:0}
  .srcbook-load .btn{flex:none}
  #page-spells.excluded #spellbody{display:none}

  /* ---- paper mini (fold-over standee, auto-built from the portrait) ---- */
  .mini-wrap{display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:28px; align-items:flex-start; padding:8px 2px}
  .mini-col{display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; gap:10px}
  .mini-embed{position:relative; width:38mm; aspect-ratio:113.501 / 504.697;
    background:url("data:image/svg+xml;base64,") center/100% 100% no-repeat}
  .mini-embed .mp{position:absolute; background-size:contain; background-position:center; background-repeat:no-repeat}
  .mini-embed .mp-front{left:19.02%; top:39.02%; width:62.41%; height:26.39%}
  .mini-embed .mp-back {left:19.02%; top:11.23%; width:62.41%; height:26.39%; transform:rotate(180deg)}  /* flipped so it reads upright once folded over the top crease */
  .mini-instructions{width:64mm; aspect-ratio:181.334 / 90.333;
    background:url("data:image/svg+xml;base64,") center/100% 100% no-repeat}
  .mini-cap{font-size:11px; color:var(--muted); text-align:center; max-width:64mm; line-height:1.4}
  #page-mini.excluded .mini-wrap{display:none}
  #page-mini.excluded .mini-hidden-note{display:block}
  .mini-hidden-note{display:none; color:var(--muted)}
  /* Companions & Forms */
  .comp-head{display:flex; gap:12px; align-items:flex-start; margin-bottom:10px}
  .comp-portrait{width:128px; height:160px; flex:none; border:1px solid var(--line2); background:var(--field);
    cursor:pointer; overflow:hidden; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; font-size:9px; color:var(--muted); text-align:center}
  .comp-portrait.has-img{background:transparent}
  .comp-portrait img{width:100%; height:100%; object-fit:contain}   /* fit the whole image, no crop */
  .comp-pickrow{display:flex; gap:8px; margin-top:6px; align-items:center}
  .comp-pickrow input{flex:1}
  .comp-pickrow select{width:auto; min-width:150px}
  .comp-rm{flex:none; border:1px solid var(--line2); background:#fff; color:var(--muted); border-radius:8px; cursor:pointer; padding:6px 9px; font-size:12px}
  .comp-rm:hover{color:#b42318; border-color:#b42318}
  .comp-stats{display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(6,1fr); gap:8px; margin-bottom:8px}
  .comp-abilities{display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(6,1fr); gap:8px; margin-bottom:8px}
  .comp-ab{background:var(--field); border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:10px; padding:6px 4px; text-align:center}
  .comp-ab .k{font-size:8px; letter-spacing:.06em; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--muted)}
  .comp-ab input{text-align:center; font-weight:700; padding:2px; border:none; background:transparent}
  .comp-ab .m{font-size:11px; font-weight:700; color:var(--accent)}
  .comp-stat .k{font-size:8px; letter-spacing:.06em; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--muted)}
  .comp-stat input{text-align:center; font-weight:700; padding:3px}
  .comp-lines{display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; gap:6px 12px; margin-bottom:8px}
  .comp-line{display:flex; gap:6px; align-items:baseline}
  .comp-line .k{font-size:9px; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:.04em; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--muted); white-space:nowrap}
  .comp-line input{flex:1; padding:3px 5px}
  .comp-block textarea{min-height:60px; line-height:1.5}
  .comp-tmpl-note{font-size:11px; color:var(--accent); margin:0 0 8px}
  .atk-top{display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:flex-start; gap:10px; margin-bottom:10px}
  .atk-top h2{margin:0}
  .atk-per-box{min-width:96px; flex:none}
  .atk-per-box .calc{min-height:24px; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center}   /* writable on a blank sheet */
  .sp-tag{display:inline-block; font-size:8px; font-weight:700; line-height:1; padding:1px 3px; border-radius:3px;
    background:var(--accent-soft); color:var(--accent); vertical-align:middle; margin-left:2px}
  .sp-addrow td{padding:2px 4px; border-top:none}
  .sp-add{font:inherit; font-size:12px; font-weight:600; color:var(--muted); background:none; border:none; cursor:pointer; padding:3px 2px}
  .sp-add:hover{color:var(--accent); text-decoration:underline}
  .spellhead{display:grid; grid-template-columns:1.4fr .8fr 1fr 1fr 1fr; gap:10px; align-items:end}
  .spellhead.spellhead-lvl{grid-template-columns:1.3fr .7fr .8fr 1fr 1fr 1fr}   /* extra sheets add a Class Level dropdown */
  .spellhead .stat .calc{min-height:30px; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center}   /* room to write on a blank sheet */
  @media (max-width:560px){ .spellhead, .spellhead.spellhead-lvl{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr} }
  .slots{display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(9,1fr); gap:8px}
  @media (max-width:560px){ .slots{grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr)} }
  .slot{background:var(--field); border:1px solid var(--line); padding:6px 5px; text-align:center}
  .slot .k{font-size:9px; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:.04em; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--muted); margin-bottom:4px}
  .slot-io{display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; gap:4px}
  .slot-io .io span{display:block; font-size:7px; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:.03em; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--muted); margin-bottom:1px}
  .slot-io .io input{width:100%; box-sizing:border-box; text-align:center; font-size:15px; font-weight:700; background:#fff; border:1px solid var(--line); padding:2px}
  .spelltable input{background:var(--field)}
  .spelltable .col-prep{text-align:center}
  .spelltable.hide-prep .col-prep{display:none}
  .spelltable td.col-comp, .spelltable td.col-time, .spelltable td.col-range,
  .spelltable td.col-dur, .spelltable td.col-school{font-size:11px; color:var(--muted); text-align:center}   /* values stay small + muted */
  .spelltable th.col-comp, .spelltable th.col-time, .spelltable th.col-range,
  .spelltable th.col-dur, .spelltable th.col-school{text-align:center}   /* headers use the global th font/size/style (centered over their values) */
  .spelltable .col-name[title]{cursor:help}
  .spelltable .sp-section td{background:var(--field); font-weight:800; font-size:10px; letter-spacing:.07em;
    text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--accent); padding:6px 8px; border-top:2px solid var(--line2)}

  /* ---- Flat / sharp theme: square corners, no shadows, no shading ---- */
  *{border-radius:0 !important; box-shadow:none !important}
  .toolbar{backdrop-filter:none !important; background:#fff !important}
  input,select,textarea,.stat input,.charname input{background:#fff !important}
  input:focus,select:focus,textarea:focus{outline:none !important; border-color:var(--accent) !important}
  /* badges drawn with hairlines instead of tinted fills */
  .ability .mod,.row .total,.passive,.chip,.stat,.gen-status .chip-val{
    background:#fff !important; border:1px solid var(--line2) !important;
  }
  /* flat segmented method selector (no elevation on the active tab) */
  .modes{background:#fff !important; border:1px solid var(--line2) !important; padding:0 !important; gap:0 !important}
  .mode-btn{border-right:1px solid var(--line2) !important}
  .mode-btn:last-child{border-right:none !important}
  .mode-btn.active{background:var(--accent) !important; color:#fff !important}
  /* toggled-on states stay flat solid accent (a colour, not a shadow) */
  .chip.on{background:var(--accent) !important; border-color:var(--accent) !important}
  .chip.on .v,.chip.on .k{color:#fff !important}
  .stat.on{background:var(--accent) !important; border-color:var(--accent) !important}
  .stat.on .k,.stat.on .calc{color:#fff !important}

  /* ---- print: dense, standardized, one page ---- */
  @media print{
    :root{--bg:#fff; --shadow:none}
    @page{size:letter; margin:8mm}
    html,body{background:#fff; padding:0; font-size:9px;
      -webkit-print-color-adjust:exact; print-color-adjust:exact}
    /* hide builder/interaction chrome — print character data only */
    .toolbar,.noprint,.gen-status{display:none !important}
    .sheet{margin:0; max-width:none; padding:0}
    .pagetabs{display:none !important}
    .page{display:block !important}                 /* print every page... */
    .page:not(#page-core){break-before:page}  /* ...each on its own sheet */
    .page.excluded{display:none !important}          /* any page hidden via Settings (or mini w/o portrait) won't print */
    #page-mini .mini-wrap{gap:12mm}
    /* keep the on-screen two-column grouping (left = abilities/saves/skills, right = combat/etc.) */
    #page-core{display:flex !important; flex-direction:column; gap:8px; min-height:261mm}   /* fill the printed sheet; even gaps between cards */
    #page-core .columns{flex:1 1 auto; grid-template-rows:1fr}                     /* row fills the page; stacks stretch into it */
    .columns{display:grid; grid-template-columns:290px 1fr; gap:8px; align-items:stretch}
    .stack{display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:8px}
    .card.grow .ta-print{min-height:0}   /* fill via flex, not a fixed floor */
    #page-inv{display:flex !important; flex-direction:column; gap:8px; min-height:261mm}     /* fill the printed sheet; even gaps between cards */
    #page-spells:not(.excluded), .page.spell-extra:not(.excluded), #page-bg:not(.excluded), #page-companion:not(.excluded), .page[data-page^="overflow-"]:not(.excluded){display:flex !important; flex-direction:column; gap:8px}   /* even card separation; :not(.excluded) so a hidden page stays hidden */
    .comp-portrait{display:flex !important; width:112px; height:140px}   /* companion art prints (was screen-only); fit-to-size */
    .comp-portrait:not(.has-img){display:none !important}               /* but don't print an empty placeholder box */
    #page-inv .card.grow, .page[data-page^="overflow-"] .card.grow{flex:1 1 auto}   /* Equipment Notes / overflow Inventory takes the remaining height */
    #page-inv .invtable td input{padding:3px 2px}                                  /* inventory rows tall enough to write in */
    /* Background page: fill one sheet and let the six text cards share the height so the whole tab fits on a single page */
    #page-bg{min-height:261mm}
    #page-bg .card:not(:first-child){flex:1 1 0; display:flex; flex-direction:column}
    #page-bg .card:not(:first-child) .ta-print{flex:1 1 auto; min-height:34px}

  /* ============================================================
     MOBILE VIEW  —  folded in from "Character Sheet (Mobile).html".
     ------------------------------------------------------------
     Every rule is scoped under html.mobile (NOT an @media query) so
     the view can be forced on at any width via the toolbar "Mobile"
     button. A boot-time matchMedia check (see the script before
     </body>) also adds html.mobile automatically below 820px wide.
     With no .mobile class the sheet renders exactly like before, and
     nothing here touches the data model, autosave, or @media print.
     ============================================================ */
  .mobile-save{ display:none; }   /* floating Save: hidden unless mobile view is on */

  html.mobile input, html.mobile select, html.mobile textarea{ font-size:16px; }   /* iOS won't zoom a focused field at >=16px */
  html.mobile body{ padding-bottom:calc(40px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px)); }   /* clear the home-bar / gesture area */

  /* kill the legacy ~300ms double-tap delay on tap targets (keeps pinch-zoom + scroll) */
  html.mobile *, html.mobile *::before, html.mobile *::after{ touch-action:manipulation; }
  /* flat/sharp on mobile: square any hard-coded radii that bypass --radius (dropdowns, pills) */
  html.mobile *, html.mobile *::before, html.mobile *::after{ border-radius:0 !important; }

  /* --- Toolbar: hand the pinned top spot to the page tabs --- */
  html.mobile .toolbar{ position:static; gap:6px; padding:8px 10px; }
  html.mobile .toolbar .brand{ width:100%; margin:0 0 4px; font-size:13px; }
  html.mobile .toolbar .btn{ flex:1 1 auto; min-height:42px; padding:9px 10px; }
  html.mobile .toolbar .status{ width:100%; order:5; min-width:0; text-align:center; }

  /* --- Always-reachable floating Save (the static toolbar scrolls off the top) --- */
  html.mobile .mobile-save{
    display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
    position:fixed; right:12px; bottom:calc(12px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px));
    z-index:40; min-height:46px; padding:0 18px; font-size:14px; font-weight:600;
    border:1px solid var(--accent);
  }

  /* --- Page tabs: a single pinned, swipeable row --- */
  html.mobile .sheet{ margin:0 auto 16px; padding:0 10px; }
  html.mobile .pagetabs{
    position:sticky; top:0; z-index:15;
    margin:0 -10px 14px; padding:8px 10px 0;
    gap:4px; flex-wrap:nowrap; overflow-x:auto;
    -webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch; scrollbar-width:none;
    overscroll-behavior-x:contain;   /* stop a swipe past the end from rubber-banding the page */
    background:var(--bg);
  }
  html.mobile .pagetabs::-webkit-scrollbar{ display:none; }
  html.mobile .ptab{ flex:0 0 auto; min-height:42px; padding:9px 15px; }

  /* --- Cards: a touch tighter on a narrow screen --- */
  html.mobile .card{ padding:13px; margin-bottom:13px; }

  /* --- Header: portrait centered above the identity fields --- */
  html.mobile .header-grid{ flex-direction:column; align-items:center; gap:12px; }
  html.mobile .header-main{ width:100%; }
  html.mobile .charname input{ font-size:21px; }

  /* --- Stack the big two-column regions --- */
  html.mobile .columns, html.mobile .topblock{ grid-template-columns:1fr; }
  html.mobile .topblock-left{ gap:13px; }

  /* --- Bigger touch targets for toggles & steppers --- */
  html.mobile input[type=checkbox],html.mobile input[type=radio]{ width:20px; height:20px; }
  html.mobile .stepper .step{ width:30px; height:38px; font-size:18px; }

  /* --- Modals: near full-screen, with their own internal scroll --- */
  html.mobile .modal{ padding:0; align-items:stretch; }
  html.mobile .modal-panel,
  html.mobile #wizard .modal-panel,
  html.mobile .settings-panel{ max-width:none; min-height:100%; border:0; }
  /* svh (static) so a full-screen modal footer doesn't clip behind / resize with the iOS address bar */
  @supports (height:1svh){
    html.mobile .modal-panel,
    html.mobile #wizard .modal-panel,
    html.mobile .settings-panel{ min-height:100svh; }
  }
  html.mobile #wizard.modal{ padding:0; }
  html.mobile .modal-body{ padding:14px; overscroll-behavior:contain; }
  html.mobile .modal-head{ position:sticky; top:0; z-index:2; background:#fff; }
  html.mobile .modal-foot{ position:sticky; bottom:0; z-index:2; background:#fff; }

  /* --- Settings: keep its section nav as a scrollable row --- */
  html.mobile .settings-wrap{ flex-direction:column; }
  html.mobile .settings-nav{ width:auto; flex-direction:row; border-right:none;
    border-bottom:1px solid var(--line); overflow-x:auto; }
  html.mobile .settings-nav .set-tab{ border-left:none; border-bottom:2px solid transparent; white-space:nowrap; }
  html.mobile .settings-nav .set-tab.active{ border-bottom-color:var(--accent); }
</style>

It also deals double damage to objects and structures.\nDivine Mattock. As an action, you can call upon the might of the All-Father and use the adze to cast move earth or fabricate. Once this property is used, it can't be used again until the next dawn.","Bigby's Beneficent Bracelet":"This gorgeous jewelry piece, crafted by the wizard Bigby himself, consists of four gold rings attached via delicate chains to a wrist cuff studded with sapphires and diamonds.\nRandom Properties. The bracelet has the following random properties, determined by rolling on the appropriate table in the Dungeon Master's Guide:\n• 1 minor beneficial property\n• 1 major beneficial property\n• 1 minor detrimental property\nDexterous Fingers. While wearing the bracelet, you can cast mage hand.\nForce Sculpture. By focusing and channeling the bracelet's magic for 1 minute, you can create a spectral copy of a Large or smaller nonmagical object. The copy appears in an unoccupied space within 10 feet of you, and it is made of tangible but translucent force that mimics the size, weight, and other properties of the object it's copying. The copy must appear on a surface or liquid that can support it. Creatures can touch and interact with the copy as if it were a nonmagical object.\nThe copy is immune to all damage and can't be dispelled, but a disintegrate spell destroys it immediately. Otherwise, the copy disappears after 8 hours or when you dismiss it as an action.\nThe bracelet can create up to three copies and regains all expended uses at dawn.\nHelpful Hand. As an action, you can use the bracelet to cast Bigby's hand as a 9th-level spell (spell attack bonus +13). When you cast the spell this way, the spell doesn't require concentration. Once the rune has been invoked, it can't be invoked again until the next dawn.","Delver's Claws":"The back of this weatherworn leather glove is adorned with three large metal hooks shaped like a mole's claws. You then regain a number of hit points equal to the total roll plus your Constitution modifier.\nOnce the rune has been invoked, it can't be invoked again until the next dawn.","Harp of Gilded Plenty":"This golden harp is sculpted in the image of the god Iallanis, depicted as a young cloud giant woman. If you fail, you can't attempt to attune to the harp again until the next dawn. Once you have successfully attuned to the harp, the harp resizes to suit you.\nStalwart Song. Whenever you make a Charisma check while attuned to the harp, you can treat a roll of 9 or lower on the die as a 10.\nFeast of Plenty. If you spend 10 minutes playing the harp, you can cast the heroes' feast spell from it. Once this property is used, it can't be used again until 1d10 + 10 days have passed.\nSoothing Melody. As an action, you can use the harp to cast the calm emotions spell (save DC 19). When the spell is cast using the harp, its duration increases to 1 hour, provided you maintain concentration on the spell. This property can be used five times, and it regains all uses at dawn.\nSentience. The harp is a sentient, chaotic good object with an Intelligence of 13, a Wisdom of 15, and a Charisma of 20. It can also communicate telepathically with the creature attuned to it.\nThe harp has a dramatic and pompous personality, taking extreme","Helm of Perfect Potential":"This copper-hued helm contains a shard of the Elemental Chaos embedded in its forehead, surrounded by a motif of a rising sun. The helm has the following random properties, determined by rolling on the appropriate table in the Dungeon Master's Guide:\n• 2 minor beneficial properties\n• 1 major beneficial property\n• 1 minor detrimental property\nMaster of Guile. They are slightly shorter than humans on average, ranging from well under 5 feet tall to just over 6 feet. They are more slender than humans, weighing only 100 to 145 pounds. Males and females are about the same height, and males are only marginally heavier than females.\nElves' coloration encompasses the normal human range and also includes skin in shades of copper, bronze, and almost bluish-white, hair of green or blue, and eyes like pools of liquid gold or silver. Elves have no facial and little body hair. They favor elegant clothing in bright colors, and they enjoy simple yet lovely jewelry."},{"name":"A Timeless Perspective","text":"Elves can live well over 700 years, giving them a broad perspective on events that might trouble the shorter-lived races more deeply. They are more often amused than excited, and more likely to be curious than greedy. They tend to remain aloof and unfazed by petty happenstance. When pursuing a goal, however, whether adventuring on a mission or learning a new skill or art, elves can be focused and relentless. They are slow to make friends and enemies, and even slower to forget them. They reply to petty insults with disdain and to serious insults with vengeance.\nLike the branches of a young tree, elves are flexible in the face of danger. They trust in diplomacy and compromise to resolve differences before they escalate to violence. They have been known to retreat from intrusions into their woodland homes, confident that they can simply wait the invaders out. But when the need arises, elves reveal a stern martial side, demonstrating skill with sword, bow, and strategy."},{"name":"Hidden Woodland and Realms","text":"Most elves dwell in small forest villages hidden among the trees. Elves hunt game, gather food, and grow vegetables, and their skill and magic allow them to support themselves without the need for clearing and plowing land. They are talented artisans, crafting finely worked clothes and art objects. Their contact with outsiders is usually limited, though a few elves make a good living by trading crafted items for metals (which they have no interest in mining).\nElves encountered outside their own lands are commonly traveling minstrels, artists, or sages. Human nobles compete for the services of elf instructors to teach swordplay or magic to their children."},{"name":"Haughty but Gracious","text":"Although they can be haughty, elves are generally gracious - even to those who fall short of their high expectations - which is most non-elves. Still, they can find good in just about anyone.\nDwarves. \"Dwarves are dull, clumsy oafs. But what they lack in humor, sophistication, and manners, they make up in valor. And I must admit, their best smiths produce art that approaches elven quality.\"\nHalflings. \"Halflings are people of simple pleasures, and that is not a quality to scorn. They're a good folk, they care for each other and tend their gardens, and they have proven themselves tougher than they seem when the need arises.\"\nHumans. \"All that haste, their ambitions and drive to accomplish something before their brief lives pass away - human endeavors seem so futile sometimes. But then you look at what they have accomplished, and you have to appreciate their achievements. If only they could slow down and learn some refinement.\""},{"name":"Exploration and Adventure","text":"Elves take up adventuring out of wanderlust. But even these wanderers love peace, food, hearth, and home, though home might be a wagon jostling along a dirt road or a raft floating downriver."},{"name":"Small and Practical","text":"The diminutive halflings survive in a world full of larger creatures by avoiding notice or, barring that, avoiding offense. Standing about 3 feet tall, they appear relatively harmless and so have managed to survive for centuries in the shadow of empires and on the edges of wars and political strife. They are inclined to be stout, weighing between 40 and 45 pounds.\nHalflings' skin ranges from tan to pale with a ruddy cast, and their hair is usually brown or sandy brown and wavy. They have brown or hazel eyes. Halfling men often sport long sideburns, but beards are rare among them and mustaches even more so. They like to wear simple, comfortable, and practical clothes, favoring bright colors.\nHalfling practicality extends beyond their clothing. They're concerned with basic needs and simple pleasures and have little use for ostentation. Even the wealthiest of halflings keep their treasures locked in a cellar rather than on display for all to see. They have a knack for finding the most straightforward solution to a problem, and have little patience for dithering."},{"name":"Kind and Curious","text":"Halflings are an affable and cheerful people. They cherish the bonds of family and friendship as well as the comforts of hearth and home, harboring few dreams of gold or glory. Even adventurers among them usually venture into the world for reasons of community, friendship, wanderlust, or curiosity. They love discovering new things, even simple things, such as an exotic food or an unfamiliar style of clothing.\nHalflings are easily moved to pity and hate to see any living thing suffer. They are generous, happily sharing what they have even in lean times."},{"name":"Blend into the Crowd","text":"Halflings are adept at fitting into a community of humans, dwarves, or elves, making themselves valuable and welcome. The combination of their inherent stealth and their unassuming nature helps halflings to avoid unwanted attention.\nHalflings work readily with others, and they are loyal to their friends, whether halfling or otherwise. They can display remarkable ferocity when their friends, families, or communities are threatened."},{"name":"Pastoral Pleasantries","text":"Most halflings live in small, peaceful communities with large farms and well-kept groves. They rarely build kingdoms of their own or even hold much land beyond their quiet shires. They typically don't recognize any sort of halfling nobility or royalty, instead looking to family elders to guide them. Families preserve their traditional ways despite the rise and fall of empires.\nMany halflings live among other races, where the halflings' hard work and loyal outlook offer them abundant rewards and creature comforts. Some halfling communities travel as a way of life, driving wagons or guiding boats from place to place and maintaining no permanent home."},{"name":"Affable and Positive","text":"Halfling try to get along with everyone else and are loath to make sweeping generalizations-especially negative ones.\nDwarves. \"Dwarves make loyal friends, and you can count on them to keep their word. But would it hurt them to smile once in a while?\"\nElves. \"They're so beautiful! Their faces, their music, their grace and all. It's like they stepped out of a wonderful dream. They live fully in the present-making them well suited to the adventuring life-but also plan for the future, striving to leave a lasting legacy. Individually and as a group, humans are adaptable opportunists, and they stay alert to changing political and social dynamics."},{"name":"Lasting Institutions","text":"Where a single elf or dwarf might take on the responsibility of guarding a special location or a powerful secret, humans found sacred orders and institutions for such purposes. Each time you gain a wizard level, you can add two wizard spells of your choice to your spellbook. You can copy a spell from your own spellbook into another book—for example, if you want to make a backup copy of your spellbook. Once this special action is used, it can't be used again until the next dawn.","Axe of the Dwarvish Lords":"Seeing the peril his people faced, a young dwarf prince came to believe that his people needed something to unite them. Thus, he set out to forge a weapon that would be such a symbol.\nVenturing deep under the mountains, deeper than any dwarf had ever delved, the young prince came to the blazing heart of a great volcano. With the aid of Moradin, the dwarven god of creation, he first crafted four great tools: the Brutal Pick, the Earthheart Forge, the Anvil of Songs, and the Shaping Hammer. With them, he forged the Axe of the Dwarvish Lords.\nArmed with the artifact, the prince returned to the dwarf clans and brought peace. His axe ended grudges and answered slights. The clans became allies, and they threw back their enemies and enjoyed an era of prosperity. This young dwarf is remembered as the First King. When he became old, he passed the weapon, which had become his badge of office, to his heir. The rightful inheritors passed the axe on for many generations.\nLater, in a dark era marked by treachery and wickedness, the axe was lost in a bloody civil war fomented by greed for its power and the status it bestowed. Centuries later, the dwarves still search for the axe, and many adventurers have made careers of chasing after rumors and plundering old vaults to find it.\nMagic Weapon. The Axe of the Dwarvish Lords is a magic weapon that grants a +3 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with it. The axe also functions as a belt of dwarvenkind, a dwarven thrower, and a sword of sharpness.\nRandom Properties.             `<thead><tr><th class="col-prep" style="width:34px">Prep</th><th class="col-name">Name</th><th class="col-comp" style="width:44px">Comp</th><th class="col-time" style="width:62px">Cast Time</th><th class="col-range" style="width:62px">Range</th><th class="col-dur" style="width:84px">Duration</th><th class="col-school" style="width:66px">School</th></tr></thead>`+
            `<tbody id="${S('spells')}"></tbody>`+
          `</table>`+
