They are slightly shorter than humans on average, ranging from well under 5 feet tall to just over 6 feet. They are more slender than humans, weighing only 100 to 145 pounds. Males and females are about the same height, and males are only marginally heavier than females.\nElves' coloration encompasses the normal human range and also includes skin in shades of copper, bronze, and almost bluish-white, hair of green or blue, and eyes like pools of liquid gold or silver. Elves have no facial and little body hair. They favor elegant clothing in bright colors, and they enjoy simple yet lovely jewelry."},{"name":"A Timeless Perspective","text":"Elves can live well over 700 years, giving them a broad perspective on events that might trouble the shorter-lived races more deeply. They are more often amused than excited, and more likely to be curious than greedy. They tend to remain aloof and unfazed by petty happenstance. When pursuing a goal, however, whether adventuring on a mission or learning a new skill or art, elves can be focused and relentless. They are slow to make friends and enemies, and even slower to forget them. They reply to petty insults with disdain and to serious insults with vengeance.\nLike the branches of a young tree, elves are flexible in the face of danger. They trust in diplomacy and compromise to resolve differences before they escalate to violence. They have been known to retreat from intrusions into their woodland homes, confident that they can simply wait the invaders out. But when the need arises, elves reveal a stern martial side, demonstrating skill with sword, bow, and strategy."},{"name":"Hidden Woodland and Realms","text":"Most elves dwell in small forest villages hidden among the trees. Elves hunt game, gather food, and grow vegetables, and their skill and magic allow them to support themselves without the need for clearing and plowing land. They are talented artisans, crafting finely worked clothes and art objects. Their contact with outsiders is usually limited, though a few elves make a good living by trading crafted items for metals (which they have no interest in mining).\nElves encountered outside their own lands are commonly traveling minstrels, artists, or sages. Human nobles compete for the services of elf instructors to teach swordplay or magic to their children."},{"name":"Haughty but Gracious","text":"Although they can be haughty, elves are generally gracious - even to those who fall short of their high expectations - which is most non-elves. Still, they can find good in just about anyone.\nDwarves. \"Dwarves are dull, clumsy oafs. But what they lack in humor, sophistication, and manners, they make up in valor. And I must admit, their best smiths produce art that approaches elven quality.\"\nHalflings. \"Halflings are people of simple pleasures, and that is not a quality to scorn. They're a good folk, they care for each other and tend their gardens, and they have proven themselves tougher than they seem when the need arises.\"\nHumans. \"All that haste, their ambitions and drive to accomplish something before their brief lives pass away - human endeavors seem so futile sometimes. But then you look at what they have accomplished, and you have to appreciate their achievements. If only they could slow down and learn some refinement.\""},{"name":"Exploration and Adventure","text":"Elves take up adventuring out of wanderlust. But even these wanderers love peace, food, hearth, and home, though home might be a wagon jostling along a dirt road or a raft floating downriver."},{"name":"Small and Practical","text":"The diminutive halflings survive in a world full of larger creatures by avoiding notice or, barring that, avoiding offense. Standing about 3 feet tall, they appear relatively harmless and so have managed to survive for centuries in the shadow of empires and on the edges of wars and political strife. They are inclined to be stout, weighing between 40 and 45 pounds.\nHalflings' skin ranges from tan to pale with a ruddy cast, and their hair is usually brown or sandy brown and wavy. They have brown or hazel eyes. Halfling men often sport long sideburns, but beards are rare among them and mustaches even more so. They like to wear simple, comfortable, and practical clothes, favoring bright colors.\nHalfling practicality extends beyond their clothing. They're concerned with basic needs and simple pleasures and have little use for ostentation. Even the wealthiest of halflings keep their treasures locked in a cellar rather than on display for all to see. They have a knack for finding the most straightforward solution to a problem, and have little patience for dithering."},{"name":"Kind and Curious","text":"Halflings are an affable and cheerful people. They cherish the bonds of family and friendship as well as the comforts of hearth and home, harboring few dreams of gold or glory. Even adventurers among them usually venture into the world for reasons of community, friendship, wanderlust, or curiosity. They love discovering new things, even simple things, such as an exotic food or an unfamiliar style of clothing.\nHalflings are easily moved to pity and hate to see any living thing suffer. They are generous, happily sharing what they have even in lean times."},{"name":"Blend into the Crowd","text":"Halflings are adept at fitting into a community of humans, dwarves, or elves, making themselves valuable and welcome. The combination of their inherent stealth and their unassuming nature helps halflings to avoid unwanted attention.\nHalflings work readily with others, and they are loyal to their friends, whether halfling or otherwise. They can display remarkable ferocity when their friends, families, or communities are threatened."},{"name":"Pastoral Pleasantries","text":"Most halflings live in small, peaceful communities with large farms and well-kept groves. They rarely build kingdoms of their own or even hold much land beyond their quiet shires. They typically don't recognize any sort of halfling nobility or royalty, instead looking to family elders to guide them. Families preserve their traditional ways despite the rise and fall of empires.\nMany halflings live among other races, where the halflings' hard work and loyal outlook offer them abundant rewards and creature comforts. Some halfling communities travel as a way of life, driving wagons or guiding boats from place to place and maintaining no permanent home."},{"name":"Affable and Positive","text":"Halfling try to get along with everyone else and are loath to make sweeping generalizations-especially negative ones.\nDwarves. \"Dwarves make loyal friends, and you can count on them to keep their word. But would it hurt them to smile once in a while?\"\nElves. \"They're so beautiful! Their faces, their music, their grace and all. It's like they stepped out of a wonderful dream. They live fully in the present-making them well suited to the adventuring life-but also plan for the future, striving to leave a lasting legacy. Individually and as a group, humans are adaptable opportunists, and they stay alert to changing political and social dynamics."},{"name":"Lasting Institutions","text":"Where a single elf or dwarf might take on the responsibility of guarding a special location or a powerful secret, humans found sacred orders and institutions for such purposes. Each time you gain a wizard level, you can add two wizard spells of your choice to your spellbook. You can copy a spell from your own spellbook into another book—for example, if you want to make a backup copy of your spellbook. Once this special action is used, it can't be used again until the next dawn.","Axe of the Dwarvish Lords":"Seeing the peril his people faced, a young dwarf prince came to believe that his people needed something to unite them. Thus, he set out to forge a weapon that would be such a symbol.\nVenturing deep under the mountains, deeper than any dwarf had ever delved, the young prince came to the blazing heart of a great volcano. With the aid of Moradin, the dwarven god of creation, he first crafted four great tools: the Brutal Pick, the Earthheart Forge, the Anvil of Songs, and the Shaping Hammer. With them, he forged the Axe of the Dwarvish Lords.\nArmed with the artifact, the prince returned to the dwarf clans and brought peace. His axe ended grudges and answered slights. The clans became allies, and they threw back their enemies and enjoyed an era of prosperity. This young dwarf is remembered as the First King. When he became old, he passed the weapon, which had become his badge of office, to his heir. The rightful inheritors passed the axe on for many generations.\nLater, in a dark era marked by treachery and wickedness, the axe was lost in a bloody civil war fomented by greed for its power and the status it bestowed. Centuries later, the dwarves still search for the axe, and many adventurers have made careers of chasing after rumors and plundering old vaults to find it.\nMagic Weapon. The Axe of the Dwarvish Lords is a magic weapon that grants a +3 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with it. The axe also functions as a belt of dwarvenkind, a dwarven thrower, and a sword of sharpness.\nRandom Properties.             `<thead><tr><th class="col-prep" style="width:34px">Prep</th><th class="col-name">Name</th><th class="col-comp" style="width:44px">Comp</th><th class="col-time" style="width:62px">Cast Time</th><th class="col-range" style="width:62px">Range</th><th class="col-dur" style="width:84px">Duration</th><th class="col-school" style="width:66px">School</th></tr></thead>`+
            `<tbody id="${S('spells')}"></tbody>`+
          `</table>`+

        `<button class="btn noprint" data-addspellsheet type="button" style="margin-top:8px; font-size:11px; padding:4px 10px">+ Add spell sheet</button>`+
      `</div>`+
      `</section>`;
  }
  function appendSpellSheet(kind){               // add one more independent spell sheet (page + tab)
    const inst = spellSheets;
    kind = kind || spellSheetKind[inst] || "manual";   // restore uses the saved kind; the + button passes 'manual'
    spellSheetKind[inst] = kind;
    $("page-companion").insertAdjacentHTML("beforebegin", spellSheetPageHTML(inst, kind));
    document.querySelector('#pagetabs .ptab[data-page="companion"]')
      .insertAdjacentHTML("beforebegin", `<button class="ptab spell-tab" data-page="${sx(inst,'spells')}" type="button">Spells ${inst+1}</button>`);
    sEl(inst,"slots").innerHTML = slotsHTML(inst);
    spellSheets++;
    renderSpellStyle(false, inst);
  }
  function removeExtraSpellSheets(){             // tear down all extra sheets (DOM only; state arrays are rebuilt by applyAll)
    document.querySelectorAll('.page.spell-extra').forEach(el => el.remove());
    document.querySelectorAll('#pagetabs .spell-tab').forEach(el => el.remove());
    spellSheets = 1;
  }
  function setSpellSheets(n){ removeExtraSpellSheets(); for(let i=1;i<Math.max(1, n||1);i++) appendSpellSheet(); }
  function spellSheetUsed(inst){                 // does an extra sheet hold anything? (drives print exclusion)
    if((sEl(inst,"spellclass").value||"").trim()) return true;
    const e = spellEntriesByInst[inst] || {};
    for(const l in e) if((e[l]||[]).some(r => (r.name||"").trim())) return true;
    if(Object.keys(preparedByInst[inst] || {}).length) return true;
    return false;
  }

  // ---- The automation ----
  // Character level is read from the top "Class & Level" field (sum of any numbers, e.g. multiclass).
  function charLevel(){                                   // null when no level is entered yet
    const m = ($("classlevel").value || "").match(/\d+/g);
    if(!m) return null;
    return Math.min(20, Math.max(1, m.reduce((a,b)=>a+parseInt(b,10),0)));
  }
  // ---- Experience points + leveling ----
  const XP_THRESH = [0,0,300,900,2700,6500,14000,23000,34000,48000,64000,85000,100000,120000,140000,165000,195000,225000,265000,305000,355000];   // total XP to BE level L (index 1..20)
  function xpToLevel(xp){ let l = 1; for(let L=2; L<=20; L++){ if(xp >= XP_THRESH[L]) l = L; else break; } return l; }
  function renderXpTracker(){   // keep the Experience field in sync with the leveling method + current level (lightweight: no input rebuild, so typing isn't interrupted)
    const inp = $("xp"), stat = $("xp-status"), btn = $("btn-levelup"), addInp = $("xp-add"), addBtn = $("btn-addxp"); if(!inp || !stat || !btn) return;
    const lvl = charLevel() || 1, atMax = lvl >= 20, xpMode = levelMethod !== "milestone";
    inp.style.display = xpMode ? "" : "none";
    if(addInp) addInp.style.display = xpMode ? "" : "none";
    if(addBtn) addBtn.style.display = xpMode ? "" : "none";
    if(xpMode){
      const xp = Math.max(0, num(inp.value, 0)), need = atMax ? null : XP_THRESH[lvl + 1];
      stat.textContent = "Level " + lvl + (need != null ? " · " + xp.toLocaleString() + " / " + need.toLocaleString() + " XP to " + (lvl + 1) : " · max XP");
      btn.hidden = !(need != null && xp >= need); btn.disabled = false;
    } else {
      stat.textContent = "Level " + lvl + (atMax ? " · max" : "");
      btn.hidden = false; btn.disabled = atMax;
    }
  }
  function addXp(){   // add the "gained" amount to the XP total so players don't have to do the arithmetic
    const add = Math.round(num($("xp-add").value, 0)); if(!add){ $("xp-add").value = ""; return; }
    $("xp").value = String(Math.max(0, Math.round(num($("xp").value, 0)) + add));
    $("xp-add").value = "";
    save(); renderXpTracker();
    flashStatus((add >= 0 ? "Added " : "Removed ") + Math.abs(add).toLocaleString() + " XP — total " + Math.round(num($("xp").value,0)).toLocaleString() + ".");
  }
  // Level up: open the class builder with N levels to assign, so you can advance a class or multiclass.
  function levelUp(){
    if(!characterCreated || !charClasses.length){ flashStatus("Create a character first (Create Character)."); return; }
    if(!DATA){ alert("Leveling up needs sourcebook data loaded."); return; }
    const cur = charClasses.reduce((a,c)=>a+(c.level||0),0);
    if(cur >= 20){ flashStatus("Already at the level cap (20)."); return; }
    let target = cur + 1;
    if(levelMethod === "xp") target = Math.max(cur + 1, xpToLevel(Math.max(0, num($("xp").value, 0))));   // assign up to the level your XP has earned (at least one)
    target = Math.min(20, target);
    openWizard();                                   // pre-fills the wizard from the character, then jump to the class builder
    wizLevelTarget = target;
    const h = $("wizard").querySelector(".modal-head h2"); if(h) h.textContent = "Level Up";
    wizStep = 2; renderWizStep();
    flashStatus("Level up — assign " + (target - cur) + " level" + (target - cur === 1 ? "" : "s") + ": raise a class or add a new one, then Save.");
  }
  let _lastFeatSig = null, _lastLimSig = null;   // change-gates so compute() skips the heavy Feature-card / Limited-Features rebuilds when their inputs are unchanged
  function equippedSig(){ let s = ""; for(let i=0;i<NINV;i++){ const cb = $("invequip-"+i), nm = $("invname-"+i); if(cb && cb.checked && nm && nm.value) s += nm.value + ","; } return s; }
  function compute(){
    // Everything is BLANK until its inputs are filled — so an untouched sheet prints empty.
    const level = charLevel();
    const pb = (level == null) ? null : 2 + Math.floor((level - 1) / 4);
    const pbAdd = pb || 0;
    $("pb").textContent = (pb == null) ? "" : sgn(pb);

    const mods = {};
    ABILITIES.forEach(([k]) => {
      const s = finalScore(k);
      mods[k] = (s == null) ? null : modOf(k);
      $("mod-"+k).textContent = (mods[k] == null) ? "" : sgn(mods[k]);
      const o = $("score-"+k+"-out"); if(o) o.textContent = (s == null) ? "" : s;
    });

    ABILITIES.forEach(([k]) => {
      $("savetot-"+k).textContent = (mods[k] == null) ? "" : sgn(mods[k] + ($("savep-"+k).checked ? pbAdd : 0));
    });

    let perceptionTotal = null;
    SKILLS.forEach(([k,,ab]) => {
      if(mods[ab] == null){ $("sktot-"+k).textContent = ""; if(k==="perception") perceptionTotal = null; return; }
      const exp = $("ske-"+k).checked, prof = $("skp-"+k).checked;
      const t = mods[ab] + (exp ? pbAdd*2 : (prof ? pbAdd : 0));
      $("sktot-"+k).textContent = sgn(t);
      if(k === "perception") perceptionTotal = t;
    });
    const observant = asiChoices.some(s => (s.feat||"") === "Observant") || /observant/i.test($("senses").value||"");   // Observant: +5 passive Perception
    $("passive").textContent = (perceptionTotal == null) ? "" : (10 + perceptionTotal + (observant ? 5 : 0));

    $("init").textContent = (mods.dex == null) ? "" : sgn(mods.dex + featInitBonus());   // + Alert etc.

    // Armor Class: selected armor's base + Dex (per armor type) + AC-bonus items
    {
      const sel = $("armorsel") ? $("armorsel").value : "";
      const customEl = $("armor-custom");
      if(customEl) customEl.style.display = (sel === "Custom") ? "" : "none";   // free-form field only for Custom
      const armNote = $("armor-note"); if(armNote){ armNote.style.display = "none"; armNote.textContent = ""; }
      const modVal = $("armormod") ? $("armormod").value : "";                  // Mithral / Adamantine / +1..+3
      let bonus = acItemsState().bonus;                                          // equipped (and, if required, attuned) AC-bonus items
      let acBase, realArmor = null;
      if(sel === ""){
        acBase = null;                                                          // no armor chosen → AC blank
      } else if(sel === "Custom"){
        const m = ((customEl && customEl.value) || "").match(/-?\d+/);          // use the number you typed as the base AC
        acBase = m ? parseInt(m[0], 10) : null;
      } else {
        const armor = (sel === "Mage Armor") ? {ac:13, type:"LA"}              // Mage Armor: 13 + Dex
                    : armorByName(sel);                                        // case-insensitive (wizard gear is e.g. "Chain mail" vs data's "Chain Mail")
        if(armor && sel !== "Mage Armor") realArmor = armor;                    // a real base armor → material/enchant applies
        let base = 10, needDex = true, dexAdd = mods.dex;
        if(armor){
          base = armor.ac;
          if(armor.type === "HA"){ needDex = false; dexAdd = 0; }              // heavy: no Dex
          else if(armor.type === "MA"){ dexAdd = (mods.dex == null) ? null : Math.min(mods.dex, 2); }  // medium: Dex max 2
          // light (LA) and unarmored: full Dex
          if(armNote && armor.stealth && modVal !== "mithral"){ armNote.textContent = "Disadvantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks while worn."; armNote.style.display = ""; }  // mithral removes it
        } else if(sel === "Unarmored"){                                        // Unarmored Defense / natural armor / class & race AC
          const cls = ($("classlevel").value || "").toLowerCase();
          if(/barbarian/.test(cls)) base = 10 + (mods.con || 0);               // Barbarian: 10 + Dex + Con
          else if(/monk/.test(cls)) base = 10 + (mods.wis || 0);               // Monk: 10 + Dex + Wis
          const raceLc = ($("race").value || "").toLowerCase();                 // race Natural Armor (best of class vs. natural)
          const naKey = Object.keys(NATURAL_ARMOR).find(k => raceLc.indexOf(k) >= 0);
          if(naKey){ const na = NATURAL_ARMOR[naKey];
            if(na.fixed){ base = Math.max(base, na.base); needDex = false; dexAdd = 0; }            // Tortle: flat 17, no Dex
            else if(na.stat === "con"){ base = Math.max(base, na.base + (mods.con || 0)); needDex = false; }  // Loxodon: 12 + Con
            else base = Math.max(base, na.base);                                                   // 13 + Dex (Dex added below)
          }
          if((/sorcerer/.test(cls) && /draconic/.test(cls)) ||                  // Draconic Resilience + Dragon Hide feat → 13 + Dex
             /\bdragon hide\b/.test(($("features").value || "").toLowerCase())) base = Math.max(base, 13);
        }
        acBase = (needDex && mods.dex == null) ? null : base + (needDex ? dexAdd : 0);
      }
      if($("armormod-wrap")) $("armormod-wrap").style.display = realArmor ? "" : "none";   // material/enchant only for a real base armor
      const magicBonus = /^\+([123])$/.test(modVal) ? parseInt(modVal.slice(1), 10) : 0;
      if(realArmor && magicBonus && acBase != null) acBase += magicBonus;       // +1/+2/+3 magic armor → AC bonus
      if(armNote && realArmor){                                                 // descriptive note for material effects
        if(modVal === "adamantine"){ armNote.textContent = (armNote.textContent ? armNote.textContent + " " : "") + "Any critical hit against you becomes a normal hit (while worn)."; armNote.style.display = ""; }
        else if(modVal === "mithral" && !armNote.textContent){ armNote.textContent = "Mithral: no Stealth disadvantage or Strength requirement."; armNote.style.display = ""; }
      }
      const warforged = /warforged/.test(($("race").value || "").toLowerCase()) ? 1 : 0;   // Integrated Protection: +1 AC in any configuration
      $("ac-calc").textContent = (acBase == null) ? "" : (acBase + bonus + warforged);
    }

    // --- hit dice available = total - used ---
    {
      const totRaw = $("hd-total").value;
      if(totRaw === ""){ $("hd-avail").textContent = ""; }
      else { $("hd-avail").textContent = Math.max(0, num(totRaw,0) - num($("hd-used").value,0)); }
      if(hitDieFaces != null){                 // Hit Dice box = one die + Con mod (the short-rest heal roll)
        const cm = mods.con;
        $("hitdice").value = "1d" + hitDieFaces + (cm ? (cm > 0 ? "+"+cm : ""+cm) : "");
      }
    }
    // --- Max HP from the per-level records: sum of die rolls + Con per level (Con applied live so it stays correct) ---
    {
      const hm = $("hpmax");
      if(hm){
        if(hpRolls.length){
          const con = (mods.con == null) ? 0 : mods.con, lvl = hpRolls.length;
          hm.value = hpRolls.reduce((a,b)=>a+(+b||0),0) + con*lvl;
          hm.readOnly = true; hm.title = "Set from HP by level (Create/Edit Character → HP). Con is applied per level.";
        } else { hm.readOnly = false; hm.removeAttribute("title"); }   // no records → manual entry
      }
    }

    // --- inventory weight + carrying capacity (Strength-based) ---
    const coins = num($("pp").value)+num($("gp").value)+num($("ep").value)+num($("sp").value)+num($("cp").value);
    const coinWt = coins/50;                                   // 50 coins = 1 lb
    $("coinwt").textContent = coins ? round1(coinWt) + " lb" : "";
    let invWt = 0;
    const presentC = new Set(presentContainers());   // items in a weightless container (Bag of Holding etc.) don't count
    for(let i=0;i<NINV;i++){
      const u = rowUnit(i);
      if(u == null) continue;
      const cont = rowCont(i);
      if(cont && presentC.has(cont)) continue;
      invWt += u * rowQty(i);
    }
    const carried = invWt + coinWt;
    const carriedTxt = (carried > 0) ? round1(carried) + " lb" : "";
    $("totalwt").textContent = carriedTxt;
    $("carried").textContent = carriedTxt;
    const strScore = finalScore("str");
    const baseSpeed = speedBase;                            // base walking speed (stored; Speed box shows the modified value)
    const VARIANT_NOTE = "Thresholds use your Strength score (lb). Encumbered / Heavily are the optional variant rule.";
    const BASE_NOTE = "Carrying capacity is your Strength score × 15 (lb).";
    let speedPenalty = 0;
    const e5 = $("enc5") && $("enc5").closest(".stat"), e10 = $("enc10") && $("enc10").closest(".stat");   // variant-only threshold boxes
    if(e5) e5.style.display = variantEncumbrance ? "" : "none";
    if(e10) e10.style.display = variantEncumbrance ? "" : "none";
    const encgrid = $("enc5") && $("enc5").closest(".encgrid");   // off → 4 remaining boxes on one row
    if(encgrid) encgrid.classList.toggle("enc-4col", !variantEncumbrance);
    if(strScore == null){
      ["enc5","enc10","carry","pushdrag","encstatus"].forEach(id => $(id).textContent = "");
      $("encnote").textContent = variantEncumbrance ? VARIANT_NOTE : BASE_NOTE;
    } else {
      const enc5=strScore*5, enc10=strScore*10, carry=strScore*15;
      $("enc5").textContent = enc5+" lb"; $("enc10").textContent = enc10+" lb";
      $("carry").textContent = carry+" lb"; $("pushdrag").textContent = (strScore*30)+" lb";
      let status, note;
      if(variantEncumbrance){                              // optional variant: Encumbered / Heavily thresholds + speed penalties
        note = VARIANT_NOTE;
        if(carried > carry){ status = "Over capacity"; speedPenalty = baseSpeed||0; note = "Over capacity — you can't carry this much (more than Strength ×15)."; }
        else if(carried > enc10){ status = "Heavily encumbered"; speedPenalty = 20; note = "Heavily encumbered: speed −20 ft, and disadvantage on STR/DEX/CON ability checks, attack rolls, and saving throws."; }
        else if(carried > enc5){ status = "Encumbered"; speedPenalty = 10; note = "Encumbered: speed −10 ft."; }
        else status = "Unencumbered";
      } else {                                             // default: just carrying capacity, no Encumbrance terms or penalties
        note = BASE_NOTE;
        status = (carried > carry) ? "Over capacity" : "Within capacity";
      }
      $("encstatus").textContent = status;
      $("encnote").textContent = note;
    }
    // Heavy armor whose Strength requirement you don't meet → −10 ft (PHB armor rule)
    {
      const selArmor = armorByName($("armorsel").value || "");   // case-insensitive match (e.g. "Chain mail" → "Chain Mail")
      const mithralMod = $("armormod") && $("armormod").value === "mithral";    // mithral removes the Strength requirement
      const req = (selArmor && selArmor.strength && !mithralMod) ? parseInt(selArmor.strength, 10) : 0;
      if(req && strScore != null && strScore < req){
        speedPenalty += 10;
        $("encnote").textContent = ($("encnote").textContent ? $("encnote").textContent + " " : "") + `Speed −10 ft: ${selArmor.name} requires Strength ${req}.`;
      }
    }
    // Monk Unarmored Movement: +10 ft at L2, scaling to +30, while unarmored and not using a shield
    let speedBonus = 0;
    const clsLow = ($("classlevel").value || "").toLowerCase();
    const armorSel = $("armorsel") ? $("armorsel").value : "";
    const hasShield = hasEquippedShield();
    if(/monk/.test(clsLow) && (armorSel === "" || armorSel === "Unarmored") && !hasShield){
      const mm = clsLow.match(/monk[^\d]*(\d+)/), mlvl = mm ? parseInt(mm[1],10) : (charLevel() || 0);
      if(mlvl >= 2) speedBonus = Math.min(30, Math.floor((mlvl - 2) / 4) * 5 + 10);
    }
    // Combat Speed (page 1): box shows base − encumbrance penalty + Unarmored Movement (not while editing)
    if(document.activeElement !== $("speed"))
      $("speed").value = (baseSpeed == null) ? "" : Math.max(0, baseSpeed - speedPenalty + speedBonus) + " ft";

    // --- spellcasting (DC/attack/prepared count) — computed per spell sheet ---
    for(let inst=0; inst<spellSheets; inst++){
      const sa = sEl(inst,"spellability").value;
      if(sa && pb != null && mods[sa] != null){
        sEl(inst,"spelldc").textContent = 8 + pb + mods[sa];
        sEl(inst,"spellatk").textContent = sgn(pb + mods[sa]);
      } else { sEl(inst,"spelldc").textContent = ""; sEl(inst,"spellatk").textContent = ""; }
      // prepared casters: spells they can prepare; known casters: spells known (from class progression)
      const spName = sEl(inst,"spellclass").value, spInfo = CASTERS[spName], spLbl = sEl(inst,"prep-stat-label");
      if(spInfo && !spInfo.prepares){                 // known caster → show "Spells Known" if the class has that progression
        const cls = DATA && findBy(DATA.classes, spName), prog = cls && cls.spellsKnown;
        if(prog && prog.length){
          sEl(inst,"prep-stat").style.display = ""; if(spLbl) spLbl.textContent = "Spells Known";
          const slvl = casterClassLevel(inst);   // known/prepared counts scale with THIS class's level, not the combined multiclass level
          sEl(inst,"prepcount").textContent = (slvl != null) ? (prog[Math.min(Math.max(slvl,1),20)-1] || "") : "";
        } else sEl(inst,"prep-stat").style.display = "none";
      } else {                                        // prepared caster OR no class selected → "Can Prepare" (writable)
        sEl(inst,"prep-stat").style.display = ""; if(spLbl) spLbl.textContent = "Can Prepare";
        const slvl = casterClassLevel(inst);   // prepared count scales with THIS class's level, not the combined multiclass level
        if(spInfo && spInfo.prepares && sa && slvl != null && mods[sa] != null){
          const half = ["Paladin","Artificer"].includes(spName);
          sEl(inst,"prepcount").textContent = Math.max(1, mods[sa] + (half ? Math.floor(slvl/2) : slvl));
        } else sEl(inst,"prepcount").textContent = "";   // blank → write it in on a printed/blank sheet
      }
    }

    updateGenStatus();
    updateStepStates();
    updateSourcesFlag();
    updateAsiFlag();
    updateDecisionsFlag();
    renderXpTracker();
    refreshAtkRows();        // recompute active-weapon attack rows (live with ability/level)
    refreshEquipToggles();   // show the Equipped box on weapon/armor/magic/attunement rows
    refreshEquippedPickers();// Armor + Attunement dropdowns reflect equipped inventory items
    renderAcItems();         // auto AC-bonus items (equipped + attuned) into the Armor card
    { const hint = $("armor-hint");   // nudge: body armor sits in inventory but no armor is set, so AC is still unarmored
      if(hint){ const sel = ($("armorsel").value||"").trim(); let found = null;
        if(!sel) for(let i=0;i<NINV;i++){ const nm = $("invname-"+i), a = nm && armorByName(nm.value); if(a && ["LA","MA","HA"].includes(a.type)){ found = {name:nm.value, equip:!!($("invequip-"+i)||{}).checked}; break; } }
        if(found){ hint.style.display = ""; hint.textContent = `You have ${found.name} in your inventory but no armor is set — ${found.equip?"":"check its Equipped box, then "}pick it under Armor to apply its AC.`; }
        else hint.style.display = "none"; } }
    renderContainers();      // container carets, nesting, collapse
    { const sig = $("features").value + "" + ($("classlevel").value||"") + "" + ABILITIES.map(([k])=>modOf(k)).join(",") + "" + equippedSig();
      if(sig !== _lastLimSig){ _lastLimSig = sig; refreshLimitedFeatures(); } }   // only recompute when its inputs changed (skip on Notes/Backstory keystrokes)
    { const fv = $("features").value; if(fv !== _lastFeatSig){ _lastFeatSig = fv; renderFeatureCards(); } }   // rebuild Feature cards only when the text changed
    { const el = $("attacks-per"); if(el) el.textContent = (charLevel()==null) ? "" : String(attacksPerAction()); }   // blank → writable box on a pen-and-paper sheet
  }

  // ---- Persistence ----
  function collect(){
    const data = {};
    document.querySelectorAll("[data-save]").forEach(el => {
      data[el.id] = (el.type === "checkbox") ? el.checked : el.value;
    });
    data.inspiration = inspState;
    data.genMode = genMode;
    data.rolledArray = rolledArray;
    data.created = characterCreated;
    data.manualScores = manualScores;
    data.baseVals = baseVals;
    data.bonusVals = bonusVals;
    data.portrait = portraitData;
    data.spellSheets = spellSheets;                       // multi-sheet spell state
    data.spellSheetKind = spellSheetKind;
    data.spellEntriesByInst = spellEntriesByInst;
    data.preparedByInst = preparedByInst;
    data.spellMaxByInst = spellMaxByInst;
    data.spellEntries = spellEntriesByInst[0];            // backward-compat: an older reader still sees sheet 0
    data.spellMaxLevel = spellMaxByInst[0];
    data.preparedSpells = preparedByInst[0];
    data.hiddenPages = hiddenPages;
    data.showAddSpell = showAddSpell;
    data.hidePortrait = hidePortrait;
    data.variantEncumbrance = variantEncumbrance;
    data.showFuturistic = showFuturistic;
    data.showModern = showModern;
    data.hitDieFaces = hitDieFaces;
    data.charClasses = charClasses;
    data.charCustomBg = charCustomBg;
    data.charBgChoices = charBgChoices;

  <!-- ============================================================
       MOBILE VIEW — toggle + auto-on. Folded in from the standalone
       mobile sheet. Adds/removes the html.mobile class that drives the
       mobile rules in <style> above; it touches no character data.
       Default is auto-on below 820px wide. The toolbar "Mobile" button
       sets an explicit on/off preference, remembered per browser.
       Also adds a second #pagetabs listener (it does NOT replace the
       main one) so that, in mobile view, tapping a tab centres it in
       the swipeable bar and jumps back to the top of the page.
       ============================================================ -->
  <script>
  (function(){
    var MV_KEY = "dnd_sheet_mobileview";              // "on" | "off"; absent = auto (width-based)
    var mq = window.matchMedia("(max-width:820px)");
    function pref(){ try{ return localStorage.getItem(MV_KEY); }catch(e){ return null; } }
    function effective(){ var p = pref(); if(p === "on") return true; if(p === "off") return false; return mq.matches; }
    function apply(){
      var on = effective();
      document.documentElement.classList.toggle("mobile", on);
      var btn = document.getElementById("btn-mobile");
      if(btn){ btn.setAttribute("aria-pressed", on ? "true" : "false"); btn.classList.toggle("primary", on); }
    }
    var btn = document.getElementById("btn-mobile");
    if(btn) btn.addEventListener("click", function(){
      try{ localStorage.setItem(MV_KEY, effective() ? "off" : "on"); }catch(e){}   // flip relative to what's showing now
      apply();
    });
    // track width only while the user hasn't pinned an explicit preference
    var onMq = function(){ if(pref() === null) apply(); };
    if(mq.addEventListener) mq.addEventListener("change", onMq); else if(mq.addListener) mq.addListener(onMq);
    var tabs = document.getElementById("pagetabs");
    if(tabs) tabs.addEventListener("click", function(e){
      var b = e.target.closest(".ptab");
      if(!b || !effective()) return;
      b.scrollIntoView({inline:"center", block:"nearest", behavior:"smooth"});
      window.scrollTo({top:0, behavior:"smooth"});
    });
    apply();
  })();
  </script>

# Browser Render (flash-free HTML → image)

When you need to render a local HTML/SVG file to a PNG or PDF to inspect it (e.g. checking how a generated page, character sheet, or report looks), do NOT launch Chrome with `--headless=new`. On macOS that mode spins up a real GPU/window surface and produces a visible **white screen flash** on every launch. In a tight render→check→fix loop that strobes the whole display every few seconds and reads, to the user, like something is repeatedly taking a screenshot. (This was the cause of a real "my screen keeps flashing" report on 2026-06-03 — a render loop on the D&D character sheet.)

Important: the flash is purely cosmetic — headless Chrome screenshots a **file**, never the user's actual screen, so there is no privacy/capture concern. But it is alarming and unnecessary. Use a flash-free path.

## Preferred: `--headless=old`

One-flag change. The legacy headless mode renders fully offscreen (no window surface, no flash):

```bash
CHROME="/Applications/Google Chrome.app/Contents/MacOS/Google Chrome"
"$CHROME" --headless=old --disable-gpu --no-first-run \
  --user-data-dir=/tmp/render-$$ --hide-scrollbars \
  --window-size=1000,1400 --screenshot=/tmp/out.png \
  "file:///tmp/page.html"
```

Verified to still produce a PNG on Chrome 148 (2026-06-03), even though old headless was nominally removed around Chrome 132 — the flag is still honored. **Caveat:** confirmed it *renders*; the no-flash behavior was not visually self-verified (can't see the screen from a tool). If you switch a loop to `--headless=old` and the user still reports flashing, Chrome is likely aliasing `old`→`new` on their version — fall back to Playwright below.

## Robust fallback: Playwright (best for JS-heavy pages)

If `--headless=old` still flashes, or the page needs real JS execution / interaction (clicking tabs, waiting on load), use Playwright's true-headless Chromium — it does not create an on-screen window on macOS:

```bash
# one-time: pip install playwright && playwright install chromium
python3 - <<'PY'
from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright
with sync_playwright() as p:
    b = p.chromium.launch()                 # headless by default, no flash
    pg = b.new_page(viewport={"width":1000,"height":1400})
    pg.goto("file:///tmp/page.html")
    pg.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    # pg.click('.ptab[data-page="spells"]')  # real interaction if needed
    pg.screenshot(path="/tmp/out.png", full_page=True)
    b.close()
PY
```

## Other options (static HTML only, no JS)

- `qlmanage -t -s 1400 -o /tmp "/tmp/page.html"` — macOS Quick Look, native, no flash, but ignores most JS.
- `wkhtmltoimage page.html out.png` — old WebKit, offscreen, no flash; weak JS. (`brew install --cask wkhtmltopdf`)

## Cleanup

Each Chrome render leaves a throwaway `--user-data-dir` and PNG in `/tmp`. Use a unique dir per call (e.g. `/tmp/render-$$`) and sweep stale ones afterward:

```bash
rm -rf /tmp/render-* /tmp/cs* /tmp/cnd*   # stale headless profiles
```

## Rule of thumb

Default to `--headless=old`. Reach for Playwright when the page is JS-driven or the flash persists. Never leave a raw `--headless=new` in a loop that runs while the user is at the machine.
